findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_ride" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Books a ride in Addis Ababa at the fixed fare from quote_ride. ALWAYS confirm pickup, drop-off, tier, fare and the rider's Ethiopian phone number with the user …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_events, list_films, search_knowledge, find_pool_groups, list_news · Public sink: list_pool_corridors, find_pool_groups, get_tender · Destructive: request_ride.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_events, list_films, search_knowledge, find_pool_groups, list_news · Public sink: list_pool_corridors, find_pool_groups, get_tender · Destructive: request_ride

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
